scope: Owner-cache repair of the disconnected producer draft. Text inspection only. The redesigned tests were not executed. No recipe was launched, no deadline was reset, and the unlinked object was not promoted.
liveContinuation: live_continuation is a context manager. It authenticates the on-disk header payload and the research-terminal-observation parent/child payload by exactly one retained journal observation each, then holds artifact_storage.workspace_lease across research_kernel.retain_existing_run and the caller with-block. It does not return a decision record. export_deadline supplies the original startedMonotonic and deadlineMonotonic and those values are not replaced. LiveCustody.record_execution is required while the lease is held, and require_live fails after release. run_sealed is not called: an existing header still returns a non-executing resume observation there, and that function is outside this edit grant.
journalAuthentication: Authority is the immutable observation identity from reasoning_history.read_journal, using the same normalized run_record match as retain_existing_run. The outer receipt journal sha256 is not sufficient. A header mutation whose journal sha256 is rewritten to the new file digest still lacks the retained observation, even when export_deadline accepts that digest.
genericFramework: The module no longer contains the object attempt, the object recipe, the denied source-core recipe path, the object run cache path, or a hardcoded full budget. Those values are caller arguments to assess_fresh_whole_build and to the tests.
fixtures: Tests place isolated custody under .cache/fixtures/dev-first-allocation/<pid-and-uuid>, which fixture_root accepts. Teardown removes only that private directory. It does not unlink .cache/workspace-leases and it does not remove a task build directory. The previous unsafe fixture was replaced and was not executed.
expiredContinuation: export_deadline raises TimeoutError when the original monotonic deadline has passed. The module does not replace that deadline.
missingTransition: run_sealed on an existing header indexes it with retain_existing_run and returns a resume observation with executionLaunched false, without a workspace lease. A new directory is admitted only with prior unset and a fresh deadline of started plus the recipe budget. sync_build_source continues the in-place gambit-core tree only by rewriting source-state run and custody under a new running inherited lease. checked_build_migration does not lease the tree or carry elapsed time. No existing function keeps dev-resume-limit-object-v1 and dev-resume-limit-object unchanged, leaves deadlineMonotonic unchanged, and admits a distinct attempt at the original 600 second budget without using evidence/fixtures/dev-resume-current-core/source-core.recipe.json. assess_fresh_whole_build does not call those functions.
nonObjectMigration: preserve_non_object_migration still returns the checked_build_migration record when the predecessor is not gambit.object and the successor is not gambit.source-core.
